construct: flex-wrap: wrap on a flex container
why: Chip rows and tag groups wrap in every target system, and the canvas has the native twin (layoutWrap: 'WRAP'). LayoutSchema.wrap has declared the fact since v15 and the emitter has lowered it since v15 — but the four-property enrichment vocabulary never contained flex-wrap, so nothing in the pipeline ever DETECTED it. A schema slot with no producer is the shape schema.wrap-declared-never-detected named.
expectWhere: anatomy.root.layout.wrap (mirrored to the CSS spelling `flex-wrap: wrap`)
